JOURNEY 01

Role-Based Sign-In & Header Banner Themes

/login Customer / Staff / Admin
StepWhere to Click / UI ElementAction / InputExpected Result (UI, API, Audit & Kafka)
1Email Quick Fill or Inputs (#login-email, #login-password)Click one of the Demo Accounts Quick-Fill buttons on the left (e.g. customer@capi.test, staff@capi.test, admin@capi.test) or type credentials (Password123!).Redirects by role: CUSTOMER -> /customer (Blue bg-capi-blue banner + MailHog CUSTOMER_LOGIN_SECURITY_ALERT), STAFF -> /staff (Black bg-black banner), ADMIN -> /admin (Greyish Silver banner); POST /api/v1/auth/login emits LOGIN_SUCCESS.
2'Sign In Securely' (#login-submit-btn)Click 'Sign In Securely'.Validates credentials with brute-force rate limiters (5 failures = 900s lockout; 20 IP failures/300s = 429) and issues tokenVersion-bound JWT.
3App Header BannerInspect top navigation banner after login.Role theme updates instantly so operators and customers can visually distinguish profiles at a glance.
JOURNEY 02

'It Wasn't Me' Emergency Fraud Lockdown & 6-Digit OTP Reset

/fraud-report -> /reset-password-verify Customer
StepWhere to Click / UI ElementAction / InputExpected Result (UI, API, Audit & Kafka)
1'Confirm & Lock Account' (#confirm-fraud-lock-btn)Open the 'It Wasn't Me' link from MailHog (:8025) login alert email and click 'Confirm & Lock Account'.POST /api/v1/auth/report-fraud immediately locks the user account, bumps tokenVersion to revoke active JWTs, logs ACCOUNT_LOCKED_FRAUD_REPORTED, and emails a 6-digit OTP.
2'Enter 6-Digit OTP & Reset Password'After #fraud-locked-confirmation displays, click the reset button to open /reset-password-verify.Pre-populates the locked email query parameter cleanly onto the OTP form.
36-Digit OTP Form (#reset-otp, #reset-new-password, #reset-submit-btn)Enter the 6-digit OTP from MailHog, type a new password (>= 8 chars), and click 'Verify OTP & Restore Account Access'.POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password-verify displays '#unlock-success-banner' ('Account Unlocked & Password Updated') and lets customer sign back in.
JOURNEY 03

Customer Settled Transactions & Self-Service Dispute Logging

/customer Customer (Blue Banner)
StepWhere to Click / UI ElementAction / InputExpected Result (UI, API, Audit & Kafka)
1'Log Dispute' button on Transaction RowOn /customer, click the red 'Log Dispute' button beside any settled transaction.Opens '#log-dispute-panel' pre-populated with merchant, payment rail, location, and amount.
2Dispute Form Fields (#dispute-category, #dispute-reason, #dispute-file-input)Adjust Transaction Type/Category if needed, confirm statement (5-2000 chars), and optionally select up to 5 PDF/PNG/JPG files (<= 5 MB each).Client prepares multipart form payload; server validates file magic bytes & computes SHA-256 checksums.
3'Submit Dispute' (#submit-dispute-btn)Click 'Submit Dispute'.POST /api/v1/disputes (Redis SET NX EX idempotency locked) shows '#dispute-created-banner' ('Reference: DSP-2026-XXXXX — Status: LOGGED') and emits DISPUTE_CREATED to Kafka.
JOURNEY 04

Customer Dispute Case History, Filtering & Search

/customer/disputes Customer (Blue Banner)
StepWhere to Click / UI ElementAction / InputExpected Result (UI, API, Audit & Kafka)
1'Active Disputes' / 'Historic / Closed' summary cardsClick either top counter card (#active-disputes-link / #historic-disputes-link) on /customer.Navigates to /customer/disputes with the corresponding filter pre-selected.
2Search & Filter Bar (#dispute-ref-search, #filter-all-btn, #filter-active-btn, #filter-historic-btn)Search by reference or merchant, or toggle between All, Active, and Historic / Closed.Filters settled historic outcomes (RESOLVED, REFUNDED such as DSP-2026-09811, REJECTED) vs open active cases.
3'View Case' buttonClick 'View Case' on any row.Opens /disputes/:id showing statement, notes, SHA-256 evidence, and linked lineage if re-opened.
JOURNEY 05

Customer Case Reply, Evidence Upload, Escalation & Re-Open

/disputes/:id Customer (Blue Banner)
StepWhere to Click / UI ElementAction / InputExpected Result (UI, API, Audit & Kafka)
1Note Reply (#note-message-input, #add-note-submit-btn) or Upload (#detail-upload-input)Enter a reply and click 'Post Note', or choose additional evidence files and click 'Upload Evidence'.When status is PENDING_CUSTOMER_ACTION, posting a customer note automatically returns the dispute to IN_REVIEW via DisputeTransitionPolicy.
2'Escalate Dispute' buttonClick 'Escalate Dispute' in the right-hand 'Need Supervisor Review?' card.POST /api/v1/disputes/{id}/escalate transitions case to ESCALATED and emits DISPUTE_ESCALATED + SUPERVISOR_ESCALATION_ALERT.
3'Re-open / File Linked Dispute' (#reopen-dispute-btn -> #confirm-reopen-submit-btn)On a REJECTED case, expand the re-open form, enter updated statement (#reopen-reason-input), and click 'Submit Linked Dispute'.POST /api/v1/disputes/{id}/reopen creates a new LOGGED case linked via original_dispute_id ('#linked-dispute-banner' Lineage Verified) and emits DISPUTE_REOPENED_LINKED.
JOURNEY 06

Staff Call Centre KYC Lookup (SA ID & Foreign Passports)

/simulator (Step 1) Internal Staff (Black Banner)
StepWhere to Click / UI ElementAction / InputExpected Result (UI, API, Audit & Kafka)
1ID Input or Preset (#kyc-sa-id-input, #preset-kyc-*, #load-customer-details-btn)Enter SA ID (8501015800082) or Foreign Passport (ZW4829104 / NG7739201) — or click a preset chip — and click 'Load Customer Details'.GET /api/v1/omnichannel/lookup-customer loads caller profile + Foreign National / SA Citizen badge and logs CALLER_KYC_LOOKUP.
2Security & Credit Bureau Checkboxes (4 checks)Confirm at least 2 checks with the caller (Registered Cellphone, Global One Account, Active Credit Card, Active DebiCheck Mandate).Prepares verification payload while keeping customer transactions locked until confirmation.
3'Verified' (#verify-customer-btn) or 'Unverified' (#not-verified-btn)Click 'Verified' if checks pass, or 'Unverified' if caller fails verification.Pressing 'Verified' AUTOMATICALLY COLLAPSES/HIDES Step 1 (#caller-kyc-panel), shows '#kyc-verified-banner', unlocks Steps 2 & 3, and logs CALLER_KYC_VERIFIED. 'Unverified' blocks access and logs CALLER_KYC_VERIFICATION_FAILED.
JOURNEY 07

Staff Call Centre Assisted Dispute Capture (Steps 2 & 3)

/simulator (Steps 2-3) Internal Staff (Black Banner)
StepWhere to Click / UI ElementAction / InputExpected Result (UI, API, Audit & Kafka)
1'Log Dispute on Behalf' in Step 2 (#verified-customer-transactions)Click 'Log Dispute on Behalf' on the caller's settled transaction row (or clear selection for manual entry).Auto-populates Merchant, Transaction Type, Location, Amount, Category, and Statement in Step 3.
2Assisted Intake Form (#assisted-category-select, #voice-statement-input, #assisted-file-input)Verify statement, optional supporting evidence files, agent notes, and optional temporary card-hold checkbox.Prepares POST /api/v1/omnichannel/voice-call (same pattern applies for /sms-webhook intake).
3'Complete Call & Log Dispute on Behalf' (#log-voice-call-btn)Click 'Complete Call & Log Dispute on Behalf'.Creates dispute in IN_REVIEW auto-assigned to the current agent (starts StaffWorkSession), displays '#voice-call-result' + 'Open Case', redacts phone PII in internalOnly note, and emits DISPUTE_CREATED + OMNICHANNEL_DISPUTE_CONFIRMATION_PHONE_CALL.
JOURNEY 08

Staff Investigator Workbench & Case Decision Flow

/staff -> /disputes/:id Internal Staff (Black Banner)
StepWhere to Click / UI ElementAction / InputExpected Result (UI, API, Audit & Kafka)
1'My Assigned Cases' filter & 'Work on Case' linkOn /staff, filter 'My Assigned Cases' (or search #staff-dispute-search) and click 'Work on Case' on an assigned row.Opens /disputes/:id in write mode; unassigned or other-staff disputes appear Read-Only (enforced by DisputeService.ensureStaffAssignedToDispute).
2Notes Panel (#note-message-input, #requires-customer-reply-checkbox, #internal-only-checkbox)Write an investigation note, optionally check Requires Customer Reply or Internal Only, and click 'Post Note'.Requires Customer Reply transitions status to PENDING_CUSTOMER_ACTION; Internal Capi Notes stay hidden from customers.
3Investigation Actions (#status-select, #resolution-summary-input, #apply-status-btn)Click 'Escalate to Supervisor' (#escalate-supervisor-btn) OR pick status (IN_REVIEW, RESOLVED, REFUNDED, REJECTED), type summary, and click 'Apply Status'.PATCH /api/v1/disputes/{id}/status updates dispute cleanly (Bankserv delegation buttons removed), stops StaffWorkSession timer on terminal/escalation states, and emits DISPUTE_STATUS_CHANGED.
JOURNEY 09

Supervisor Case Queue, Escalations & Investigator Assignment

/admin (Tab 1) Admin / Supervisor (Greyish Silver Banner)
StepWhere to Click / UI ElementAction / InputExpected Result (UI, API, Audit & Kafka)
1'Disputes & Escalations' Tab (#tab-disputes-btn)Sign in as admin@capi.test (notice the Greyish Silver header banner) and use #admin-dispute-search to find open/escalated rows.Displays all open, escalated (highlighted amber), and closed disputes with Bankserv, Resolve, and Reject quick row buttons removed.
2Row Staff Dropdown ('Select Staff...')Select an internal staff investigator (e.g. Sipho Ndlovu or Zanele Mbeki) in the open row's dropdown.Targets an unlocked INTERNAL_CAPI STAFF/ADMIN investigator.
3'Assign' / 'Reassign' button (or 'Inspect')Click 'Assign' (or 'Reassign') on the row.POST /api/v1/admin/disputes/{id}/assign assigns case to the investigator, moves LOGGED -> IN_REVIEW, starts a StaffWorkSession timer, and logs ADMIN_DISPUTE_ASSIGNED.
JOURNEY 10

Supervisor Security & KYC Audit Trail & CSV Export

/admin (Tab 2) Admin / Supervisor (Greyish Silver Banner)
StepWhere to Click / UI ElementAction / InputExpected Result (UI, API, Audit & Kafka)
1'Audit Management' Tab (#tab-audit-btn)Click 'Audit Management' in the top command center tab bar.Calls GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs to load paginated immutable @Immutable AuditLog rows.
2Category Chips & Filters (#audit-filter-suspicious-btn, #audit-filter-kyc-btn, #audit-event-filter, #audit-search-input)Filter by Suspicious/Unverified alerts, Call Centre KYC lookups, specific event types, or free-text SA ID / email / IP search.Surfaces CALLER_KYC_*, UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS_ATTEMPT (403 IDOR probes), LOGIN_*, and ADMIN_* events sourced from capi.security.audit.events.
3'Export Audit CSV' (#export-audit-csv-btn)Click 'Export Audit CSV'.GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs/export downloads formula-sanitized CSV (<= 10,000 rows) and records AUDIT_LOG_CSV_EXPORTED.
JOURNEY 11

Supervisor Staff Productivity & Turnaround Time Report

/admin (Tab 3) Admin / Supervisor (Greyish Silver Banner)
StepWhere to Click / UI ElementAction / InputExpected Result (UI, API, Audit & Kafka)
1'Staff Productivity Report' Tab (#tab-productivity-btn)Click 'Staff Productivity Report' in the Admin portal tab bar.Calls GET /api/v1/admin/reports/productivity to fetch SQL-aggregated turnaround metrics.
2'Refresh Metrics' linkClick 'Refresh Metrics' after assigning or closing disputes to inspect live timer updates.Updates per-investigator Assigned (Active), Call Centre Auto-Assigned, Resolved / Closed, Work Sessions, Total Time, and Avg Turnaround.
3Recorded StaffWorkSession Entries TableInspect bottom audit breakdown table by Session ID, Dispute Reference, Assignment Source, Outcome, and Duration.Verifies timers automatically run between IN_REVIEW claim/assignment and escalation, resolution, refund, rejection, or reassignment.
JOURNEY 12

Supervisor Staff Provisioning, Role Catalog & Account Unlock

/admin (Tab 4) Admin / Supervisor (Greyish Silver Banner)
StepWhere to Click / UI ElementAction / InputExpected Result (UI, API, Audit & Kafka)
1'Staff, Roles & Accounts' Tab (#tab-users-btn)Click 'Staff, Roles & Accounts' in the Admin tab bar.Loads current portal users (8 seeded accounts) alongside the 4 default internal operational roles.
2Operational Roles Form (#admin-roles-panel -> #save-role-btn)Create a new role (#role-display-input, #role-base-select STAFF/ADMIN) or click 'Edit Role' on an existing role card.POST / PUT /api/v1/admin/roles persists the operational role template for staff provisioning.
3Staff Form (#admin-staff-form-panel -> #save-staff-btn) & Directory Actions ('Edit / Update Role', 'Unlock Account')Fill new staff details and click 'Add Staff Member', edit an existing user, or click 'Unlock Account' on a locked row.POST/PUT /api/v1/admin/users or POST /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/unlock updates accounts immediately and records ADMIN_* security audits.
